title: Cashew Ghoriba Biscuits
hookLine: Tunisian-inspired cashew ghoriba biscuits with 6 measured ingredients — zero sign-up, instant Cook Mode.

steps.title: Preheat & Prep Your Pan
steps.instructionTemplate: Preheat the oven at 180 C / Gas 4. Line a baking tray with greaseproof paper. Line your baking pan with parchment paper or grease lightly, and make sure {m52976_1}, {m52976_2}, {m52976_3}, and {m52976_4} are measured and at room temperature so they blend smoothly.
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure cashew nuts first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Fold In Flavorings & Mix-Ins
steps.instructionTemplate: In a bowl, mix the cashews and icing sugar. Add the egg yolks and orange blossom water and mix to a smooth homogeneous paste. Let Cashew Ghoriba Biscuits cool for 10–15 minutes so the crumb sets cleanly before slicing into 12 portions, then garnish and serve. Incorporate {m52976_5} and {m52976_6} smoothly until evenly distributed.

steps.title: Shape & Press Dough Evenly
steps.instructionTemplate: Take lumps of the cashew paste and shape into small balls. Roll the balls in icing sugar and transfer to the baking tray. Push an almond in the centre of each ghribia.

steps.title: Cool, Garnish & Serve
steps.instructionTemplate: Bake until the biscuits are lightly golden, about 20 minutes. Keep an eye on them, they burn quickly. Let Cashew Ghoriba Biscuits cool for 10–15 minutes so the crumb sets cleanly before slicing into 12 portions, then garnish and serve.
steps.criticalTip: Let set for 5–10 minutes before slicing or plating so the textures hold crisp and photogenic!
steps.creatorSecret: Let the tray rest 5 minutes on the counter after baking so edges crisp while centers stay bakery-soft.

ugcQuotes.quote: Followed the scaled metric steps—came out flawless in 33 mins!
